fields.title: A saved word and its saved page never disagree, so a book reopens where you left it
fields.description: A save can write a new word with the previous page's cfi, and reopen prefers the cfi, so a book can reopen a chapter behind (confirmed live: Flow chapter jump, then quit). Every word save sends its own cfi or null (clear); the close save uses a relocate cfi only for the same word; reopen drops a cfi whose section does not hold the saved word. Needs a src/types.ts and ReaderContainer.tsx integration window.
